name: Resume address and equipment-delivery address divergence

attribution.legal_posture: Source-attributed defensive research finding; adjudication and independent dispositive force require separate evidence.

ttps: Investigate unexplained divergence among claimed residence, tax/payroll identity, equipment destination, device enrollment, and login geography before shipping privileged endpoints.
caveats: The identity-theft victim's details and the delivery address are excluded.

statements: In Nisos's controlled candidate investigation, the requested equipment-delivery address differed from the resume address and had no connection to the real Florida resident whose identity was appropriated.

sources.support: In Nisos's controlled candidate investigation, the requested equipment-delivery address differed from the resume address and had no connection to the real Florida resident whose identity was appropriated
